policy: Maintained means manually reviewed only against the named source set and jurisdiction. It does not mean continuous retrieval, automatic alerts, legal advice, or comprehensive coverage.

maintained.scope: DEA Docket No. 1362 / Hearing Docket No. 26-96 and federal authorities necessary to explain the procedural status and bounded operator consequences of the proposed transfer of marijuana from schedule I to schedule III.
maintained.cadence: Manual review every Friday, Pacific/Honolulu; event-triggered review after a new DEA docket order, Federal Register document, final rule, or official correction.
maintained.staleBehavior: Display the record as stale, stop describing the status as current, retain the last verified as-of date, and require direct primary-source review before reliance.
maintained.failureBehavior: Preserve the last successful dated record, identify the source that could not be checked, publish no inferred change, and place the record in the human review queue.
maintained.correctionPolicy: Record the affected statement, prior and corrected text, authority, reviewer, effective date, and reason; preserve the superseded record in the correction log.
